package httpx

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestExisting(t *testing.T) {
	got := Do(1)
	if got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("first: %d", got)
	}
	if got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("second: %d", got)
	}
}

func TestOld(t *testing.T) {
	if Do(2) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("old")
	}
}

func TestNew(t *testing.T) {
	if strings.ToUpper(Name()) != "X" {
		t.Errorf("new")
	}
}
